tiktok.author: busybeesara
tiktok.body:
Not a fan of Etsy? 🙃 There are so many places you can sell print on demand that aren’t Etsy but just remember each one comes with its own set of pros and cons! I personally think Etsy is a great platform for beginners, they make it super easy to get started and drive so much traffic to their site every day. But if you need an Etsy alternative, here are a few to consider! 💖 #printondemand #printondemandtips #sidehustletiktok #printondemandforbeginners #printondemandshop where to sell print on demand. Etsy alternatives. Shopify print on demand. Printify Popup. TikTok shop print on demand.
Where to sell print on demand if you don't wanna sell on Etsy. Now, you guys know I love Etsy, especially for beginners, but not everyone loves the startup fees, the listing fees. Maybe it's not available in their country. Whatever reason you have for not wanting to sell on Etsy, let me show you some alternatives where you can still sell print on demand. I have an entire series on this first one, it's printify popup. I love this one because it's a free storefront to printify gives you where your customers pay them directly so that you don't actually have the upfront costs when you make a sale. And they've made a ton of updates over the last few months. You can really customize these now, and they also offer personalization. So if you're thinking printify popup, check out my entire series that I have on my profile. Next up is one of the newer printify options, and that's actually TikTok Shop. And I think what I love most about TikTok Shop is you really don't have to have a crazy following on TikTok to get started with this. But because it's a new platform, I think a lot of people are intimidated by it. But one of the cool things that printify did actually, is they created a top selling, fast shipping, perfect for TikTok catalogue so that you can find products that are actually optimized to be sold on TikTok Shop. Because they're gonna Ship out super fast, which is what TikTok requires. Now I have not personally ever sold on TikTok Shop as a seller. I have done it as an affiliate. But if you guys want me to do an entire series where we do a shop together starting from scratch, just let me know because I have a lot of friends and I know a lot of sellers that started on TikTok Shop and I found a ton of success with it. And last but not least is shopify. Now shopify is very similar to printify pop up, but you can do a lot more with it. Printify has a ton of tutorials on Shopify and how you can connect it with your printify products. But I think what's so great about shopify is you can really customize this, make it your own, get emails, get a marketing list going, and just really create a super professional storefront. Now if you're still not sure where to sell your printify products or which site would be best for you, printify actually has an entire page where you can compare all the different platforms, see which ones have easy setup, look and see just more information about each one because there are so many places that you can sell your print on demand products.
